# A 21928 cap in PG(8,7).
# Quantavane, November 2026: found from Edel's 21555-cap in PG(8,7) (yvesedel.de, Matritzen/CAPs), in its
# coordinates; 20461 of its points are kept (1094 removed) and 1467 points are new.
# The 21928 points are the columns of this 9 x 21928 matrix over GF(7), one row per coordinate x0, ..., x8;
# it is a check matrix of a linear [21928,21919,4]_7 code.
# Field: GF(7), the integers modulo 7, written 0, ..., 6.
# Columns: every point is scaled so that its last nonzero coordinate is 1. Columns 1-20461 are the points of
# Edel's cap that are kept, columns 20462-21928 the new points, each group in lexicographic order of (x0, ..., x8).
